Are you someone who likes to work with your hands, solve practical problems and see the result of your work at the end of the day? You will be involved in maintaining, repairing and inspecting technical products, using tools and your practical skills to keep everything in good working condition. Your background does not have to be in maintenance specifically. Experience in a practical or technical profession, such as carpentry, construction, assembly or mechanical work can give you a strong foundation for this role. What matters is that you are technically minded, enjoy figuring out how things work and are willing to learn new skills. You will work in an international environment where you can turn the practical experience you already have into a new technical career.

If you enjoy working with your hands, using tools and fixing things rather than sitting behind a desk, this is a role where your practical skills really come into play. 
As a Maintenance Technician, you will work on the packaging systems used to safely transport and protect fragile high-tech components. These are not ordinary boxes: you will work with large wooden and metal components, inspecting, repairing and maintaining them so they are ready for their next use.

Technical understanding, attention to detail, and a strong sense of responsibility are essential for this role.
